caption: text slides for the hand-assembled access carousel — numbers match the final order

slides.title: Good light used to live behind a door.
slides.body: A room you had to book. A day rate. Lights that cost more than the camera, and someone else's diary deciding when you were allowed in. That is why studio portraits looked expensive — because they *were*.

slides.title: It was never talent. It was access.
slides.body: Two people stand in the same lobby. Same clothes, same face, same afternoon. One goes home with a portrait, the other goes home with a snapshot. The difference was a door — and most of us were on the wrong side of it.

slides.title: The door is gone.
slides.body: The lights moved to *after* the photo. No room to book, no stand to hire, nobody's Saturday to wait for. You pick the setup you want and it lands on a picture already sitting in your camera roll.

slides.title: Comment the number.
slides.body: Every light in this post has a number. Comment it and I'll send you that exact setup for your own photo. *₦1,000* per photo. No app, no sign-up, no gear.
